title: Making friends when you do not speak the same language

faq.q: How can I talk without the same language?
faq.a: Smile, point, mime, draw pictures, and play games that do not need many words, like football or tag. A translation app with a grown-up can help too.
asks: Can you make friends without talking?

faq.q: How can we learn each other's language?
faq.a: Teach each other one word a day, like hello, friend or ball. Label things you see, and practise with songs and games.
asks: Tell me about the Swap words

faq.q: How do I help a new student who speaks another language?
faq.a: Be their buddy: show them where things are, sit with them, speak slowly, use gestures, and include them in games.
asks: How can I welcome a new kid from another country?

faq.q: What if I do not understand them?
faq.a: That is okay. Smile, try gestures or drawing, and be patient. Never laugh at mistakes; learning a language is hard work.
